gtin.description: The scanned GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits). The handler only rejects a blank value (400); a value that is not a valid GTIN (wrong shape, bad check digit or a variable-measure indicator) is a 409 `invalid-scanned-gtin`.

count.description: Packs scanned - eaches for an EACH GTIN, cases for a CASE GTIN.
